changelog: iOS: the keyboard no longer covers bottom-anchored fields — the lift now comes from the OS's own keyboard height instead of being inferred, and it reaches the Add Device and Smart Schedule sheets too.
Device names are capped at 20 characters, wherever one can be typed.
A newly registered account now lands on the Add Your First Device step instead of going straight to the device list.
Device Info fills in the Sierro 1000 figures until a model is chosen, instead of showing dashes.
Android now actually asks for the notification permission when you turn on Power Outage or Low Battery.
Sleep Mode's time picker stays open — it used to close itself a moment after you opened it.
The (i) on Smart Schedule now opens the explainer: how it works, how savings are estimated, and what each parameter does.
